source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseAsyncImmediateDmlTest { @isTest static void asyncAndImmediateAliasesUseLocalDml() { Account asyncAccount = new Account(Name = 'Async'); Object asyncResult = Database.insertAsync(asyncAccount); Object saved = Database.getAsyncSaveResult(asyncResult); System.assert(saved.isSuccess()); System.assertNotEquals(null, saved.getId()); Account immediate = new Account(Name = 'Immediate Insert'); Object immediateInsert = Database.insertImmediate(immediate, false); System.assert(immediateInsert.isSuccess()); Account asyncUpdate = new Account(Id = immediateInsert.getId(), Name = 'Async Updated'); Object asyncUpdateResult = Database.updateAsync(asyncUpdate, false); System.assert(asyncUpdateResult.isSuccess()); Account immediateUpdate = new Account(Id = saved.getId(), Name = 'Immediate'); Object updateResult = Database.updateImmediate(immediateUpdate, false); System.assert(updateResult.isSuccess()); Object deleteResult = Database.deleteAsync(immediateUpdate, false); Object deleted = Database.getAsyncDeleteResult(deleteResult); System.assert(deleted.isSuccess()); Object immediateDelete = Database.deleteImmediate(asyncUpdate, false); System.assert(immediateDelete.isSuccess()); Database.QueryLocator locator = Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account'); String queryLocator = Database.getAsyncLocator(locator); System.assert(queryLocator.startsWith('local-query:SELECT Id, Name FROM Account')); String resultLocator = Database.getAsyncLocator(saved); System.assert(resultLocator.startsWith('local-result:')); System.assertEquals('already-local', Database.getAsyncLocator('already-local')); List<Account> rows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Name, IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Name = \'Immediate\' ALL ROWS'); System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals(true, rows.get(0).get('IsDeleted')); List<Account> immediateRows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Name, IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Name = \'Async Updated\' ALL ROWS'); System.assertEquals(1, immediateRows.size()); System.assertEquals(true, immediateRows.get(0).get('IsDeleted')); } }
